# hosttracker_webhooks (Data Source)

Reads the account's webhooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hosttracker_webhooks" "all" {}

# The webhooks the API has switched off after repeated delivery failures.
output "broken_webhooks" {
  value = [
    for webhook in data.hosttracker_webhooks.all.webhooks :
    webhook.url if webhook.disabled_reason != null
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_results` (Number) How many webhooks to collect across pages. Defaults to 1000. The data source walks the cursor itself and stops here.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) The webhooks' ids, in the order the API returned them.
- `webhooks` (Attributes List) The account's webhooks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `consecutive_failures` (Number) How many deliveries have failed in a row.
- `created` (Number) When the webhook was created, in Unix seconds.
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why the system switched this webhook off: `deliveryFailure` or `gone`. Null when the account switched it off, and when it is enabled.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are attempted.
- `events` (Set of String) Which event types this webhook receives.
- `headers` (Attributes Set) The custom request headers every delivery carries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks--headers))
- `id` (String) The webhook's id, which is also the `HT-Webhook` header every delivery carries.
- `last_delivery_at` (Number) When a delivery was last attempted, in Unix seconds.
- `monitor_count` (Number) How many monitors the scope resolved to, including zero.
- `name` (String) The display name.
- `resolved_monitor_ids` (Set of String) Which monitors a `tags` scope resolved to.
- `scope` (Attributes) Which monitors this webhook receives events for - exactly one of the three forms. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks--scope))
- `secret_set` (Boolean) Whether the webhook has a signing secret. The value itself is never readable.
- `secret_updated_at` (Number) When the current secret was minted, in Unix seconds.
- `updated` (Number) When the webhook was last edited, in Unix seconds.
- `url` (String) Where deliveries are POSTed.

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks.headers`

Read-Only:

- `header` (String) The header name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The header value.


<a id="nestedatt--webhooks--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks.scope`

Read-Only:

- `all` (Boolean) Set when the webhook covers every monitor on the account.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) The explicit monitor list, when the scope is one.
- `tags` (Set of String) The tags matched, when the scope is a tag one.
